id.description: This is the unique identifier for the chat to filter by.

assistantId.description: This is the unique identifier for the assistant that will be used for the chat.

assistantIdAny.description: Filter by multiple assistant IDs. Provide as comma-separated values.

squadId.description: This is the unique identifier for the squad that will be used for the chat.

sessionId.description: This is the unique identifier for the session that will be used for the chat.

previousChatId.description: This is the unique identifier for the previous chat to filter by.

columns.description: Columns to include in the CSV export

email.description:
This is the email address to send the export to.
Required if userId is not available in the request context.

format.description:
This is the format of the export.

@default csv

page.description: This is the page number to return. Defaults to 1.

sortOrder.description: This is the sort order for pagination. Defaults to 'DESC'.

sortBy.description: This is the column to sort by. Defaults to 'createdAt'.

limit.description: This is the maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.

createdAtGt.description: This will return items where the createdAt is greater than the specified value.

createdAtLt.description: This will return items where the createdAt is less than the specified value.

createdAtGe.description: This will return items where the createdAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.

createdAtLe.description: This will return items where the createdAt is less than or equal to the specified value.

updatedAtGt.description: This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than the specified value.

updatedAtLt.description: This will return items where the updatedAt is less than the specified value.

updatedAtGe.description: This will return items where the updatedAt is greater than or equal to the specified value.

updatedAtLe.description: This will return items where the updatedAt is less than or equal to the specified value.
